premises: Atomic-scale compositional heterogeneities exist in FCC HEAs like CoCrFeNi
These heterogeneities cause spatial variations in stacking fault energy (SFE)
SFE variations trigger coordinated twinning and dislocation slip
This coordination delays necking and enhances strength-ductility under loading
The mechanism operates under dynamic loading conditions
